summary: Even with C_c^infinity strict-subcap input densities positive on single compact interval interiors, one can have every frozen unnormalised rough-hub slice satisfy nu_l(I)<=(3sqrt(7)/16)|I|^(1/2) while T=2L(X-X') has continuous density with p_T(0)>=(3/16)log(1/(2epsilon))->infinity. Thus connected support and a uniform interval half-Frostman slice bound do not imply a universal rough-hub L-infinity endpoint. The quadratic matrix has spectrum {sqrt(2),-sqrt(2),0}, so this is not a counterexample to the three-large-eigenvalue conjecture.
scope_guard: Refutes only the interval-only rough-hub receiver inference; full QFORM remains open. The valid account04/B14 r7 direct shear/small-ball theorem is unaffected.
